title: Patch: prefetch a screen's code and the engine on hover or focus
thread:
**Issue #2116 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2116: Patch: prefetch a screen's code and the engine on hover or focus
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of #2036. This is a patch of its own: it goes live when it merges and builds on `main` beside the tracker's other parts.

## What

This is the "pre-rendering" tip. The crawler pages are already pre-rendered (`static-pages.ts`); the gap is code. Every route is a `lazy()` chunk (`main.tsx`) that is fetched only after the click, and the engine's WebAssembly loads only when a game starts.

- **One map of imports.** Keep each route's `import()` in a single map. `main.tsx`'s `lazy()` and a new `prefetchRoute(path)` helper both call it, so a prefetch and the route share one request.
- **When to prefetch.** Call `prefetchRoute` on `pointerenter` and `focus` of every control that navigates to a route, and on `touchstart` on touch devices. Do it once per route per page load.
- **The engine.** When the player shows intent toward Practice, Play or a match, also start `loadWasm()` (`src/wasm/index.ts`, already idempotent).
- **Save-Data.** Skip all prefetching when `navigator.connection?.saveData` is true.
- **Dev routes.** A production build never prefetches a dev-only route.

## Done when

vitest checks that:
- hovering a control calls its route's import once, and a second hover starts no new fetch;
- a prefetched route renders without showing the Suspense fallback;
- Save-Data turns all prefetching off;
- intent toward Practice starts `loadWasm()`.

## Ground rules (from #2036)

- Read `apps/web/README.md` before changing the client. CLAUDE.md rule 7: nothing here predicts, enforces or reveals game state.
- Every number is a named constant (rule 9).
- If SPEC §10 doesn't already decide a behaviour, add a ruling note numbered from this issue's own block (`docs/issues-and-patches.md`, Ruling numbers), with its proving test named after it.
- Gates: `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e`.
- The PR closes this issue, says `Part of #2036`, and carries one `## Player note` line.
```
